main.description: An electronic press kit for a project, in the Local Network root account's repo. A project can have several, one per audience, and all its managers edit them through drafts (computer.localnetwork.epk.draft), which the root publishes. The root rewrites this record on every publish, so its CID identifies the published version. This record is the public part; the rest sits in the press kit's own space (computer.localnetwork.space.epk, with the same key), which people read once a manager grants them access. Press kits made before the root held them are in the repo of the manager who made them, until that manager's next visit moves them here with the same key.

project.description: The computer.localnetwork.project record this press kit is for.

title.description: What this press kit is for, like "Clubs" or "Festivals 2027".

bio.description: A short bio anyone can read.

mixes.description: Mixes anyone can play. Tracklists stay on the project's own mixes.

photos.description: Photos anyone can see and download.
